panes.label: Overview
text: The BBA (Hons.) in Digital Branding & Advertising at ATLAS ISME is built for the next generation of

text.strong: brand storytellers, creative strategists, and digital disruptors.
building iconic brands, running viral campaigns, or shaping consumer culture

You’ll learn how to blend creativity with

text.strong: data, strategy with storytelling, and insight with innovation.

text:
From social media strategy to digital ad campaigns, content creation to brand identity design — every module is taught in the context of the real-world marketing ecosystem.

Led by

text.strong: industry mentors, advertising veterans, and digital creators, you’ll graduate with the tools, experience, and portfolio to thrive in agencies, brands, platforms — or your own startup.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: This semester builds digital branding foundations through creativity, marketing analytics, and leadership-driven, effective communication skills.

title.strong: Applied Marketing in the Digital World

courses.text: Introduces digital-first marketing strategies using online consumer journeys and real-time data to drive brand growth.
Builds foundational leadership and organizational skills through planning, decision-making, and people management practices.
Enhances verbal and written communication for professional influence, clarity, and structured business messaging.

courses.title: Atlas Elective
courses.text: Provides interdisciplinary learning opportunities, integrating analytical thinking with diverse management domains.

courses.title: Visual Thinking & Digital Creativity
courses.text: Develop creative problem-solving through visuals. Apply digital tools to express ideas and innovation.
Applies artificial intelligence to automate brand analysis, personalization, content optimization, and audience insights.
Explores behavioral patterns shaped by Indian cultural values to inform brand positioning and customer engagement.

compare.title: Why our semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS connects cultural psychology, AI experimentation, and strategic design to help students create impactful and innovative brand experiences.
